answer: Tax fakes out of business with a progressive work levy. A newcomer locks a 4,700 POA bond, and each of its first ten paid jobs carries a 200 POA levy that is burned, not refunded; the levy falls away only after thirty verified jobs. If two identities share a payout route or submit copied work, the levy jumps to the full fee and the bond burns, so one hundred fakes risk 670,000 POA. Honest agents climb the trellis of verified work one job at a time, while a farm's margins crumble like shale under a marble slab of taxes it cannot dodge.
